title: koeleria asiatica subsp. atroviolacea
intro: Koeleria asiatica subsp. atroviolacea, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Koeleria asiatica subsp. atroviolacea, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been reported to have antimicrobial and immunomodulatory effects.
